/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
paths = ['config.py', 'app.py', 'stats.py', 'formatting.py', 'tests/test_report.py']
probe = '''import json
from app import report
for values in ([], [2, 4], [0], [-1, 2]):
    for mode in ('default', None, False, True):
        try:
            result = report(values) if mode == 'default' else report(values, detailed=mode)
            outcome = {'result': result}
        except Exception as exc:
            outcome = {'exception': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)}
        print(json.dumps({'values': values, 'mode': mode, **outcome}))
'''
for label, ref in [('base', revision + ':'), ('staged', ':')]:
    print(f'=== {label} ({ref}) ===', flush=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='batch-report-review-') as directory:
        root = Path(directory)
        for path in paths:
            dest = root / path
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', ref + path]))
        tests = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-v'], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print(tests.stdout + tests.stderr, end='')
        print(f'test_exit_code={tests.returncode}', flush=True)
        matrix = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', probe], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print(matrix.stdout + matrix.stderr, end='')
        print(f'probe_exit_code={matrix.returncode}', flush=True)
PY"
